title: Team Playbook Catalog
description: Per-team offensive formation catalog for one game, derived from the Playbook Gamer research corpus. Used to find real in-game playbooks that match a requested style.

source.description: Attribution for the raw data (always 'Playbook Gamer').

verification_status.description: Corpus data is third-party sourced, so 'unverified' unless independently confirmed.

team_id.description: Slug derived from the team name.

name.description: Team or school name as it appears in the game.

playbook_style.description: Style tag where the source provides one (e.g. 'Option', 'West Coast', 'Pro Style', 'Multiple', 'Spread').

personnel_breakdown.description: Count of formations by personnel grouping code. Only present when source data includes personnel codes.

formation_families.description: Count of formations grouped by family (singleback, i_form, shotgun, etc.). Derived from formation names.

personnel.description: Personnel grouping code (e.g. '11', '12', '21'). Null when not in source data.
